NULL, shares estimated retained raw survey weights. weight_scaling Likelihood-weight scaling method. default "mean_one" scales raw weights globally sum retained sample size. Use deattenuation instead. prior_alpha_mean Numeric. Prior mean intercept logit scale. Default NULL, estimates data. prior_alpha_sd Numeric. Prior SD intercept. Default 0.5. sigma_state_prior Article prior-sensitivity selector state random-effect SD. Exactly one "half_t3_2.5" (baseline), "half_normal_1", "half_cauchy_2.5", "half_t3_5".
